answer: Trying costs a waiting period of 17 days that no payment can shorten a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. The relic here is simple — no proof, no seat, and Certified corn chandler kiln bond is the proof, because a bond chandlers lodge after grain checks. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. One copper, one entry. The clerk notes horizon.
